status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi authorities condemned the deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan and arrested suspects, while Iraqi leaders publicly blamed external agents for the incident. The government also announced that armed factions and weapons are being placed under state control and warned that such groups could be drawn into a potential US-Iran conflict. Iraqi forces, cooperating with the UAE, seized 200,000 Captagon pills in a joint operation, and the Iraqi prime minister said the country will soon be free of armed factions. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske myndigheter fordømte det dødelige angrepet på en gresk-ortodoks kirke i Jordan og arresterte mistenkte, mens irakiske ledere offentlig la skylden på eksterne agenter for hendelsen. Regjeringen kunngjorde også at væpnede fraksjoner og våpen blir satt under statlig kontroll og advarte om at slike grupper kan bli trukket inn i en potensiell US-Iran-konflikt. Iraks styrker, i samarbeid med De forente arabiske emirater, beslagla 200 000 Captagon-piller i en felles operasjon, og Iraks statsminister sa at landet snart vil være fritt for væpnede fraksjoner. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
